home.name: Home
home.h1: Trade food with trust, from farm to buyer.
home.answer: T57 connects verified producers, buyers, banks and logistics on one AI-native trade platform.

faqs.q: What is T57?
faqs.a: T57 is AI-native digital trade infrastructure for the food industry. It brings verification, quotes, contracts, finance access, insurance, inspection and logistics onto one trade record for verified members.

faqs.q: Who can join T57?
faqs.a: Any business in the food chain can apply, including farmers, fishers, processors, manufacturers, brands, traders, importers, wholesalers, supermarkets and HoReCa buyers. Every member is verified before trading.

faqs.q: Does T57 lend money or hold my funds?
faqs.a: No. T57 does not lend, hold client funds, own goods or provide transport. Finance, escrow, insurance and logistics are provided by licensed partners through the platform.

faqs.q: Which countries does T57 cover?
faqs.a: T57's founding markets are Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye. Businesses in other countries can apply for membership online.

faqs.q: How does T57 use AI?
faqs.a: AI helps with matching, risk checks, document preparation and forecasting. People make the final decisions, and any adverse decision is reviewed by a person.

home.title: T57 | AI-Native Digital Trade Infrastructure for Food
home.description: Verified food trade on one record: RFQs, contracts, trade finance, insurance, inspection and logistics for farmers, processors, traders and buyers.

who-we-serve.name: Who We Serve
who-we-serve.h1: Bring every part of the food chain into one verified trade club.
who-we-serve.answer: T57 exists to connect everyone who grows, makes, buys, finances and regulates food on one trusted record.

faqs.q: Who can join T57?
faqs.a: Any business or institution in the food chain can apply, from farmers and fishers to processors, brands, traders, importers, supermarkets, HoReCa buyers, lenders, insurers, service providers and government bodies.

faqs.q: Why does T57 verify every member?
faqs.a: Verification lets every member trade with confidence. It also gives lenders and insurers the trusted information they need to support a trade.

faqs.q: Can individuals join T57?
faqs.a: T57 is built for registered businesses and institutions. Individual farmers can join through a cooperative or producer organization.

who-we-serve.title: Who We Serve | T57 Verified Food Trade Club
who-we-serve.description: T57 connects farmers, processors, traders, buyers, financiers, service providers and regulators on one verified food trade record.

why-t57.name: Why T57
why-t57.h1: The whole food trade, on one trusted record.
why-t57.answer: Join, discover, finance, settle and close every trade on one AI-native platform, so every actor from farm to fork can see, trust and finance each transaction.

faqs.q: How is T57 different from other food trade platforms?
faqs.a: T57 is an AI-native ecosystem, working with IOFS and ASEAN, that brings trade, finance, logistics and policy-grade data together on one verified platform.

faqs.q: Why do the IOFS and ASEAN partnerships matter to me as a trader?
faqs.a: They translate into faster onboarding, clearer rules of origin and better access to tenders and sovereign buyers, because T57 aligns with the institutions that set food security and trade priorities.

faqs.q: Does T57 only serve governments and institutions?
faqs.a: No. The same rails that serve ministries and multilaterals also serve farmers, cooperatives, SMEs and enterprises, giving every player, big and small, access to verified markets and trusted counterparties.

why-t57.title: Why T57 | The AI-Native Global Food Operating System
why-t57.description: T57 is the AI-native food trade ecosystem working with IOFS and ASEAN, joining policy, finance and logistics into trusted global food flows.

club-membership.name: Club Membership
club-membership.answer: Verified food-trade club that matches vetted counterparties, reducing fraud and defaults across every global agri transaction.

faqs.q: How does the T57 trust score help farmers and producers, cooperatives, and FPOs reduce risk?
faqs.a: The trust score helps these groups assess whether prospective buyers, aggregators, processors, or service partners have the legitimacy, financial stability, trade history, and relationship strength needed to support dependable transactions. This reduces the risk of engaging with weak or opaque counterparties.

faqs.q: Why is the T57 ID useful for financiers and investors, partners, collaborators, governments, and regulators?
faqs.a: The T57 ID provides these stakeholders with a structured view of whether an organization has been verified across key trust factors, including compliance, field validation, references, and ecosystem reputation. That makes it easier to evaluate risk and engage with businesses whose credentials are supported by a more advanced process than standard marketplace profiles or basic business identifiers.

club-membership.title: T57 Club Membership | A Verified Global Food-Trade Club
club-membership.description: T57 is a curated food and agri trade club, not an open marketplace: verified IDs, trust scores and badges help members trade with confidence.

rfq-bidding.name: RFQ Bidding
rfq-bidding.h1: One request. Comparable quotes. One contract.
rfq-bidding.answer: Get comparable quotes from verified suppliers, and turn the best one into a contract.

faqs.q: Who can respond to an RFQ on T57?
faqs.a: Only verified members whose products, capacity and markets match the request. Buyers can also invite specific suppliers.

faqs.q: Can sellers see each other's bids?
faqs.a: No. Each bid is visible only to the buyer, which keeps pricing fair and confidential.

rfq-bidding.title: RFQ Bidding for Food Trade | T57
rfq-bidding.description: Send one structured RFQ to verified food suppliers, compare like-for-like bids and turn the best quote into a contract on T57.

virtual-trade-desk.name: Virtual Trade Desk
virtual-trade-desk.h1: A trade desk for every food business.
virtual-trade-desk.answer: A full trade desk for every member, with AI doing the groundwork and people deciding.

faqs.q: Is the Virtual Trade Desk a person or software?
faqs.a: Both. The Trade Desk is software that matches, prices, drafts and screens, supported by T57's trade desk team for cases that need human review.

faqs.q: Does the Trade Desk negotiate for me?
faqs.a: No. It gives you matches, price data and checks. You negotiate and decide.

virtual-trade-desk.title: Virtual Trade Desk for Food SMEs | T57
virtual-trade-desk.description: AI matching, price data, contracts from quotes and compliance screening in one trade desk for food SMEs. AI advises, people decide.

market-intelligence.name: Market & Price Intelligence
market-intelligence.h1: See the market before you move.
market-intelligence.answer: See prices, supply and risk by origin before you quote, buy or plan.

faqs.q: Where does T57's price data come from?
faqs.a: From public market sources and anonymized, aggregated trade data on T57. No individual member's prices are shared.

faqs.q: Can I use the data without trading on T57?
faqs.a: Market intelligence is part of T57 membership and is built to support trading on the platform.

market-intelligence.title: Food Market & Price Intelligence | T57
market-intelligence.description: Food prices, supply status by origin and AI forecasts inside your trade workflow. Quote, buy and plan with the full picture on T57.

trade-finance.name: Trade Finance
trade-finance.h1: One deal file. Several lenders compete.
trade-finance.answer: One verified deal file, several lenders competing to fund your food trade.

faqs.q: Does T57 provide the finance?
faqs.a: No. T57 does not lend or hold client funds. It sends your verified deal file to licensed lenders, who decide whether to fund the trade and on what terms.

faqs.q: What kinds of finance can I request?
faqs.a: Pre-shipment and post-shipment finance, receivables finance and letters of credit, through participating banks and finance companies, including Shariah-compliant options.

trade-finance.title: Trade Finance for Food SMEs | Lenders Compete | T57
trade-finance.description: Send one verified deal file to several licensed lenders and compare offers. Self-liquidating food trade finance through escrow on T57.

nft-funding.name: Digital Asset-Based Funding
nft-funding.h1: Turn trade documents into fundable assets.
nft-funding.answer: Turn verified trade documents into digital assets that funders can trust and finance.

faqs.q: Is this cryptocurrency?
faqs.a: No. A tokenized trade document is a digital record of a real asset, such as an invoice or warehouse receipt. It is not a currency.

faqs.q: Which documents can be tokenized?
faqs.a: Trade documents on a verified T57 trade record, such as invoices, warehouse receipts and bills of lading, where local law recognizes electronic trade documents.

nft-funding.title: Digital Asset Trade Finance | Tokenized Trade Documents | T57
nft-funding.description: Turn verified invoices, warehouse receipts and bills of lading into unique digital assets that lenders can trust and fund, on T57.

elc-15-minutes.name: eLC in 15 Minutes
elc-15-minutes.h1: Letters of credit, built from your contract.
elc-15-minutes.answer: Electronic letters of credit, issued in about 15 minutes once your application is approved.

faqs.q: What does "15 minutes" mean?
faqs.a: It is the target time for a partner bank to issue the electronic LC after your application has been approved. Approval itself follows the bank's own credit process.

faqs.q: Does T57 issue letters of credit?
faqs.a: No. Letters of credit are issued by licensed partner banks. T57 prepares the application from your trade record and connects you to them.

elc-15-minutes.title: Electronic Letter of Credit in About 15 Minutes | T57
elc-15-minutes.description: Electronic LCs built from your verified contract and issued by partner banks in about 15 minutes after approval. Digital documents, fewer discrepancies.

escrow-payments.name: Escrow Payments
escrow-payments.h1: Your money moves only when the goods do.
escrow-payments.answer: Your money moves only when the goods do, with escrow released at agreed milestones.

faqs.q: Who holds the money in escrow?
faqs.a: A licensed escrow partner. T57 does not hold client funds.

faqs.q: What happens if there is a dispute?
faqs.a: Release pauses automatically, and the dispute is handled under the contract and the partner's rules. Release resumes once it is resolved.

escrow-payments.title: Escrow Payments for Food Trade | Pay on Milestones | T57
escrow-payments.description: Buyers pay into escrow with a licensed partner, and funds release only when inspection, shipment or delivery milestones are met on T57.

alternative-payments.name: Alternative Payments
alternative-payments.h1: More ways to settle, within the law.
alternative-payments.answer: Settle food trades in stablecoins, digital assets or bullion-backed payments, where the law allows.

faqs.q: Are alternative payments available in every country?
faqs.a: No. They are offered only where local law allows, through regulated partners. Members in other countries settle through banks, escrow or letters of credit.

faqs.q: Does T57 hold my crypto or gold?
faqs.a: No. Custody, conversion and settlement are handled by licensed partners. T57 records the payment on the trade record.

alternative-payments.title: Stablecoin, Crypto & Bullion Payments for Food Trade | T57
alternative-payments.description: Settle cross-border food trades in stablecoins, digital assets or bullion-backed payments through regulated partners, where lawful, on T57.

digital-bank.name: Digital Bank
digital-bank.h1: Pay and get paid in any currency.
digital-bank.answer: Hold, pay and settle in any currency, near-instantly, inside your food trade.

faqs.q: Is T57 a bank?
faqs.a: No. Digital banking services on T57 are provided by licensed partners. T57 connects them to your verified profile and trade record.

faqs.q: Which currencies can I hold?
faqs.a: Any currency your trade needs. T57's banking partners hold, convert and settle across currencies, so you can pay suppliers and get paid by buyers in their own currency.

digital-bank.title: Digital Bank for Food Trade | Any Currency | T57
digital-bank.description: Hold, pay and settle in any currency with near-instant settlement from licensed partners, linked to every contract and invoice on your T57 trade record.

document-audit-trail.name: Document Management & Audit Trail
document-audit-trail.h1: Every document of a trade, on one record.
document-audit-trail.answer: Every document, approval and milestone of a trade, on one tamper-evident record.

faqs.q: Who can see my trade documents?
faqs.a: Only the parties you authorize for that trade, such as your counterparty, lender, insurer or inspector. Access is recorded in the audit trail.

faqs.q: Are documents stored on the blockchain?
faqs.a: No. Documents are stored securely, and a digital fingerprint of each key record is anchored on the ledger. This proves the document has not changed without exposing its contents.

document-audit-trail.title: Trade Document Management & Audit Trail | T57
document-audit-trail.description: Contracts, invoices, certificates and inspection reports on one tamper-evident trade record, with a full audit trail for every food trade.

capabilities.name: Capabilities
capabilities.h1: Every step of a food trade. One record.
capabilities.answer: Run every part of a food trade, from first quote to final payment, on one record.

faqs.q: Do I have to use every capability on every trade?
faqs.a: No. Members choose the capabilities each trade needs. Because they share one record, adding a service later does not mean starting again.

faqs.q: Who provides finance, payments and insurance?
faqs.a: Licensed partners. T57 does not lend, hold client funds, own goods or provide transport. It provides the verification, workflow and trade record that connect these services.

faqs.q: Can I use T57 for domestic trade as well as exports?
faqs.a: Yes. T57 supports domestic wholesale to supermarkets, HoReCa and institutions, as well as cross-border trade. See domestic B2B trade .

capabilities.title: T57 Capabilities | Every Step of Food Trade on One Record
capabilities.description: RFQs, contracts, trade finance, escrow, eLCs, insurance, logistics, customs and price intelligence for food trade, connected on one T57 trade record.

cap-trade.name: Trade Execution
cap-trade.h1: From first enquiry to delivered deal.
cap-trade.answer: Turn a food trade opportunity into an agreed, delivered and documented deal.

faqs.q: Can I use Trade Execution without finance or logistics?
faqs.a: Yes. You can use RFQs, contracts and traceability on their own, and add finance, insurance or logistics to any trade later.

faqs.q: Does T57 sell or buy the goods?
faqs.a: No. T57 does not own goods. Members trade directly with each other on T57.

faqs.q: Which products can I trade?
faqs.a: Food across the whole chain: grown, raised and caught products, and processed, manufactured and branded goods.

cap-trade.title: Food Trade Execution | RFQs, Contracts & Traceability | T57
cap-trade.description: RFQs, contract farming, government tenders, traceability and chat-based orders, from first enquiry to delivery on one T57 trade record.

cap-rfq.name: RFQ & Trade Execution
cap-rfq.answer: Send one structured request, compare verified quotes and execute the deal you choose.

faqs.q: How long does an RFQ stay open?
faqs.a: The buyer sets the deadline. Bids received after it closes are not shown unless the buyer reopens the RFQ.

faqs.q: Can I negotiate after receiving bids?
faqs.a: Yes. You can ask clarifying questions or request a revised bid from any supplier before you award the contract.

faqs.q: Can sellers create offers without an RFQ?
faqs.a: Yes. Verified sellers can publish product listings and wholesale terms that buyers can respond to directly.

cap-rfq.title: RFQ & Trade Execution for Food | T57
cap-rfq.description: Structured RFQs, verified bidders, like-for-like comparison and contracts from the accepted quote. Source and execute food trades on one T57 record.

cap-trade-desk.name: Virtual Trade Desk
cap-trade-desk.h1: A trading house desk, without the headcount.
cap-trade-desk.answer: Give your business the trade desk of a global trading house, without hiring one.

faqs.q: Is the Trade Desk included in membership?
faqs.a: Yes. Every verified member can use the Trade Desk. Higher membership tiers include deeper data and higher usage.

faqs.q: Does the Trade Desk make decisions for me?
faqs.a: No. It provides suggestions, drafts and checks. You make every commercial decision.

faqs.q: What happens when the Trade Desk flags a problem?
faqs.a: You see the issue and a suggested fix. If the issue concerns compliance or verification, it goes to T57's team for human review.

cap-trade-desk.title: Virtual Trade Desk for Food Trade | AI + Human Review | T57
cap-trade-desk.description: AI counterparty matching, price data, contract drafting, sanctions screening and document checks for food SMEs, with people making every decision.

cap-contract-farming.name: Contract Farming
cap-contract-farming.answer: Agree next season's crop today, with buyers, growers and finance on one record.

faqs.q: Can individual smallholders use contract farming on T57?
faqs.a: Yes, usually through a cooperative or producer organization that holds the T57 membership and signs on behalf of its members.

faqs.q: What happens if prices change during the season?
faqs.a: It depends on the contract. Fixed-price, minimum-price and formula-based agreements each handle price movements differently, and the terms are agreed upfront.

faqs.q: Does T57 provide the inputs or finance?
faqs.a: No. Inputs come from buyers or partners, and finance comes from licensed lenders. T57 provides the contract, records and workflow.

cap-contract-farming.title: Contract Farming Platform | Forward Contracts for Food | T57
cap-contract-farming.description: Forward agreements, quality standards, input finance and milestone payments between buyers, farmers and cooperatives on one T57 record.

cap-tenders.name: Government Tenders
cap-tenders.h1: Win public food tenders as a verified supplier.
cap-tenders.answer: Find, answer and deliver public food tenders as a verified supplier.

faqs.q: Does T57 submit bids on my behalf?
faqs.a: No. T57 helps you find, understand and prepare a response. You submit it through the issuing authority's official channel.

faqs.q: Can government buyers use T57 to run tenders?
faqs.a: Government buyers can invite verified T57 members to bid and track delivery on T57, alongside their own procurement rules and systems.

faqs.q: Which countries' tenders are covered?
faqs.a: Tenders from T57's founding markets first (Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye), with more markets added over time.

cap-tenders.title: Government Food Tenders | Find & Win Public Contracts | T57
cap-tenders.description: Discover public food tenders, get AI summaries and eligibility checks, build compliant responses and deliver on one T57 trade record.

cap-traceability.name: Traceability
cap-traceability.h1: Prove where your food came from.
cap-traceability.answer: Prove where your food came from, how it was handled and who touched it.

faqs.q: Who adds information to a lot's record?
faqs.a: The parties who handle it, such as the producer, processor, inspector and logistics partner, each add the events they are responsible for.

faqs.q: Can consumers see traceability information?
faqs.a: Yes, if the brand or seller chooses to share it through a link or QR code. Commercial details stay private.

faqs.q: Does traceability on T57 replace certification?
faqs.a: No. Certificates are still issued by accredited bodies. T57 links them to the lots they cover and makes them easy to check.

cap-traceability.title: Food Traceability from Source to Buyer | T57
cap-traceability.description: Lot-level food traceability with verified origins, linked certificates and a tamper-evident record. Prove provenance and speed up recalls on T57.

cap-chat-orders.name: LLM-Based Orders
cap-chat-orders.h1: Order by WhatsApp. Get a real order.
cap-chat-orders.answer: Order food the way you already talk to suppliers, by WhatsApp, voice or chat.

faqs.q: Do I need to install anything?
faqs.a: No. Verified members can order through WhatsApp or T57 chat once their account is linked.

faqs.q: What if the AI gets my order wrong?
faqs.a: You always see a summary before confirming, so you can correct it. Nothing is sent to the supplier until you confirm.

faqs.q: Is my WhatsApp conversation stored?
faqs.a: Only the order details you confirm are recorded on the trade record, under T57's privacy policy.

cap-chat-orders.title: WhatsApp & AI Chat Ordering for Food Businesses | T57
cap-chat-orders.description: Order food by WhatsApp message or voice note. AI turns plain language into confirmed, structured orders on your T57 trade record.

cap-trust-payments.name: Trust & Payments
cap-trust-payments.h1: Pay and get paid with confidence.
cap-trust-payments.answer: Pay and get paid with confidence, on terms both sides can see and trust.

faqs.q: Which payment option should I choose?
faqs.a: Escrow suits most new relationships and domestic wholesale. eLCs suit larger cross-border trades where a bank guarantee is expected. Wallet payments suit trusted, repeat relationships.

faqs.q: Can I combine payment options?
faqs.a: Yes. For example, a deposit can be paid into escrow and the balance under an LC, all on the same trade record.

faqs.q: Who resolves payment disputes?
faqs.a: Disputes are handled under the contract and the licensed partner's rules. Release pauses automatically until they are resolved.

cap-trust-payments.title: Trust & Payments for Food Trade | Escrow, Wallets, eLC | T57
cap-trust-payments.description: Escrow, wallets in any currency and electronic letters of credit from licensed partners, tied to milestones on one verified T57 trade record.

cap-escrow.name: Escrow & Trade Assurance
cap-escrow.h1: Payment held safely until the goods are right.
cap-escrow.answer: Hold payment safely until the goods, the quality and the documents are right.

faqs.q: Who holds the money?
faqs.a: A licensed escrow partner, in an account separate from T57 and from both trading parties.

faqs.q: What does escrow cost?
faqs.a: Escrow fees are set by the partner and shown before you agree the contract.

faqs.q: Can escrow be used with a letter of credit or trade finance?
faqs.a: Yes. Escrow can sit alongside an LC or repay a trade finance lender at settlement, on the same trade record.

cap-escrow.title: Escrow & Trade Assurance for Food Trade | T57
cap-escrow.description: Buyer funds held by licensed escrow partners and released in stages on inspection, shipment or delivery, with dispute triggers, on T57.

cap-wallet.name: Digital Wallet & Payments
cap-wallet.h1: One wallet for every trade payment.
cap-wallet.answer: One wallet for every trade payment, in any currency, linked to every invoice.

faqs.q: Is the T57 wallet a bank account?
faqs.a: It is an e-money or payment account provided by a licensed partner. For full banking services, see Digital Banking.

faqs.q: Can I pay people who are not on T57?
faqs.a: Yes. You can pay external suppliers and service providers by bank transfer from your wallet, subject to the partner's checks.

faqs.q: What are the fees?
faqs.a: Fees and exchange rates are set by the payment partner and shown before you confirm each payment.

cap-wallet.title: Digital Wallet for Food Trade Payments | Any Currency | T57
cap-wallet.description: Pay suppliers and partners and get paid by buyers in any currency, with near-instant member payments and automatic reconciliation on T57.

cap-elc.name: Electronic Letter of Credit
cap-elc.h1: Letters of credit, built from your contract.
cap-elc.answer: Letters of credit built from your contract, issued digitally and presented without paper.

faqs.q: What does "about 15 minutes" mean?
faqs.a: It is the target time for issuance after the bank has approved your application. Approval follows the bank's normal credit process.

faqs.q: Can my own bank issue the LC on T57?
faqs.a: If your bank is a T57 partner, yes. If not, T57 can connect you to participating banks.

faqs.q: Are electronic LCs legally valid?
faqs.a: Letters of credit are commonly issued and advised electronically between banks. Electronic presentation of trade documents depends on local law, and T57 supports paper presentation where it is still required.

cap-elc.title: Electronic Letter of Credit (eLC) for Food Trade | T57
cap-elc.description: LCs built from your contract, issued by partner banks in about 15 minutes after approval, with AI discrepancy checks and digital presentation on T57.

cap-banking.name: Banking & Money Movement
cap-banking.h1: Bank and move money where you trade.
cap-banking.answer: Bank, convert and move money across borders, in any currency, where you trade.

faqs.q: Is T57 a bank?
faqs.a: No. T57 connects verified members to licensed banking and payment partners and links their services to the trade record.

faqs.q: Can I keep my existing bank?
faqs.a: Yes. You can keep using your own bank and connect it to T57, or use T57's partners alongside it.

faqs.q: Are digital-asset services available everywhere?
faqs.a: No. They are offered only where the law allows, through regulated partners.

cap-banking.title: Banking & Money Movement for Food Trade | T57
cap-banking.description: Digital banking, accounts in any currency, cross-border transfers and regulated digital-asset settlement for verified food businesses on T57.

cap-digital-bank.name: Digital Banking
cap-digital-bank.h1: Business banking, opened with your Passport.
cap-digital-bank.answer: Business banking built around your food trade, opened with your T57 Passport.

faqs.q: Who provides the bank account?
faqs.a: A licensed banking partner in your market, under its own terms and regulation.

faqs.q: Do I have to move my existing banking?
faqs.a: No. You can use T57's banking partners alongside your current bank.

faqs.q: Which countries are covered?
faqs.a: T57's founding markets first (Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye), with more added as partners join.

cap-digital-bank.title: Digital Business Banking for Food Businesses | T57
cap-digital-bank.description: Business accounts in any currency, cards and near-instant settlement from licensed partners, opened with your T57 Passport and linked to every trade.

cap-any-currency.name: Any-Currency Accounts & Remittance
cap-any-currency.h1: Any currency. Rates you see first.
cap-any-currency.answer: Hold, convert and send money in any currency, at rates you see before you pay.

faqs.q: Which currencies can I hold and send?
faqs.a: Any currency your trade needs, through T57's banking and payment partners.

faqs.q: How long do transfers take?
faqs.a: Payments between T57 members settle in near real time. External transfers depend on the destination and partner network, and the expected time is shown before you confirm.

faqs.q: Can I send personal remittances?
faqs.a: Where partners offer it, verified business members can send remittances for staff. T57 is built for business payments, not personal accounts.

cap-any-currency.title: Any-Currency Accounts for Food Trade | T57
cap-any-currency.description: Hold, convert and send money in any currency with upfront rates and fast cross-border transfers, linked to every trade on T57.

cap-digital-assets.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
cap-digital-assets.h1: Settle in stablecoins or gold-backed tokens.
cap-digital-assets.answer: Settle trades in stablecoins, digital assets or gold-backed tokens, through regulated partners.

faqs.q: Is digital-asset settlement legal in my country?
faqs.a: T57 shows digital-asset options only where they are permitted for both parties under local rules, through licensed partners.

faqs.q: What about price volatility?
faqs.a: Stablecoins and gold-backed tokens are designed to reduce volatility, and partners can convert to local currency at the point of payment.

faqs.q: Are digital-asset payments Shariah-compliant?
faqs.a: Views differ among scholars. Members who need Shariah-compliant settlement should seek guidance and can choose gold-backed tokens or conventional options instead.

cap-digital-assets.title: Crypto, Stablecoin & Gold-Token Trade Settlement | T57
cap-digital-assets.description: Settle food trades in stablecoins, digital assets or gold-backed tokens through licensed partners, where lawful, linked to your T57 trade record.

cap-financing.name: Financing & Capital
cap-financing.h1: Fund every stage of your food trade.
cap-financing.answer: Fund every stage of your food trade, from planting and production to shipment and sale.

faqs.q: Who provides the finance?
faqs.a: Licensed banks, finance companies, Islamic finance providers and, where permitted, institutional investors. T57 does not lend.

faqs.q: What do lenders see?
faqs.a: Only the deal file you choose to share: your T57 Passport, the contract, counterparties, documents and trade history.

faqs.q: How does repayment work?
faqs.a: In most structures, the end buyer's payment goes into escrow and repays the lender at settlement, before the balance is released to you.

cap-financing.title: Food Trade Financing & Capital | Lenders Compete | T57
cap-financing.description: Trade and supply chain finance, Shariah-compliant finance and tokenized funding for verified food trades, from competing licensed lenders on T57.

cap-supply-chain-finance.name: Trade & Supply Chain Finance
cap-supply-chain-finance.answer: Get working capital at every step of the food chain, from lenders competing for your trade.

faqs.q: How quickly can I receive offers?
faqs.a: That depends on each lender's process. Because the deal file is already verified, lenders can respond faster than to a standard application.

faqs.q: Do I need collateral?
faqs.a: Many structures rely on the trade itself, through confirmed orders, invoices and escrow repayment, rather than on property or other collateral. Each lender sets its own requirements.

faqs.q: Can large buyers offer finance to their suppliers?
faqs.a: Yes. Through payables finance, an anchor buyer can let its verified suppliers be paid early by partner lenders.

cap-supply-chain-finance.title: Trade & Supply Chain Finance for Food SMEs | T57
cap-supply-chain-finance.description: Pre-shipment, post-shipment, receivables, payables and inventory finance for verified food trades, with lenders competing and escrow repayment on T57.

cap-fundraising.name: Asset-Based Fundraising & Tokenization
cap-fundraising.h1: Raise capital against real food assets.
cap-fundraising.answer: Raise capital against real food assets, from verified trades to warehouse stock and farm equipment.

faqs.q: Is this the same as crypto?
faqs.a: No. A tokenized asset is a digital record of a real asset, such as an invoice or a cold store. It is not a currency.

faqs.q: Who can invest?
faqs.a: Licensed lenders, and investors eligible under the rules of the licensed fundraising platform and their own country.

faqs.q: What happens if the trade fails?
faqs.a: The outcome depends on the structure. Funders may have rights to the underlying asset, insurance or guarantees, which are set out before they commit.

cap-fundraising.title: Asset-Based Fundraising & Tokenization for Food | T57
cap-fundraising.description: Tokenize verified invoices, warehouse receipts and food assets so licensed lenders and investors can fund them, where the law allows, on T57.

cap-risk.name: Risk & Protection
cap-risk.h1: Protect every trade from loss and default.
cap-risk.answer: Protect every trade against loss, default and disruption, with cover built from the trade record.

faqs.q: Does T57 sell insurance?
faqs.a: T57 connects members to licensed insurers, takaful operators and brokers. Policies are issued by them, under their own regulation.

faqs.q: Can I use my existing insurer?
faqs.a: Yes. You can upload existing policies to the trade record so they can be used with LCs, lenders and claims.

faqs.q: What does compliance screening check?
faqs.a: Sanctions lists, watchlists, adverse media and beneficial ownership for every counterparty, before a deal moves forward.

cap-risk.title: Trade Risk & Protection | Cargo, Credit & Takaful | T57
cap-risk.description: Cargo insurance, trade credit cover, takaful, crop cover and compliance screening for food trade, from licensed partners, linked to every T57 trade.

cap-logistics.name: Logistics & Fulfilment
cap-logistics.h1: Farm or factory to buyer, on one record.
cap-logistics.answer: Move food from farm or factory to buyer, with freight, tracking and customs on one record.

faqs.q: Can I use my own freight forwarder?
faqs.a: Yes. You can invite your forwarder to the trade record or upload its documents and tracking data.

faqs.q: Does T57 support cold-chain shipments?
faqs.a: Yes. Cold-chain partners and temperature tracking are available for chilled and frozen goods.

faqs.q: Which modes of transport are covered?
faqs.a: Sea, air and road freight, plus warehousing and cold storage, through vetted partners.

cap-logistics.title: Food Logistics & Fulfilment | Freight, Tracking, Customs | T57
cap-logistics.description: Book vetted freight, cold-chain, inspection and customs partners, track shipments in real time and clear borders faster, on one T57 trade record.

cap-logistics-network.name: Intelligent Logistics Network
cap-logistics-network.h1: Vetted freight and cold chain, matched to each trade.
cap-logistics-network.answer: Compare and book vetted freight, cold-chain and warehousing partners, matched to each trade.

faqs.q: How are logistics partners vetted?
faqs.a: Partners go through business verification, license and insurance checks, and their performance is rated on recorded shipments.

faqs.q: Can I invite my own forwarder?
faqs.a: Yes. Your existing forwarder can join the trade record and quote alongside network partners.

faqs.q: Does T57 negotiate freight rates?
faqs.a: T57 aggregates demand and shows comparable quotes, which helps members get competitive rates. Members choose and book.

cap-logistics-network.title: Food Logistics Network | Freight & Cold Chain | T57
cap-logistics-network.description: Compare and book vetted freight forwarders, carriers, cold-chain and warehousing partners matched to each food trade, with route risk alerts on T57.

cap-tracking.name: Real-Time Shipment Tracking
cap-tracking.h1: Where your food is. What state it is in.
cap-tracking.answer: Know where your food is, what condition it is in and when it will arrive.

faqs.q: Do I need special tracking devices?
faqs.a: No. T57 uses carrier and port data for all shipments. IoT devices add live temperature and location for sensitive cargo.

faqs.q: Who can see my shipment?
faqs.a: Only the parties to the trade and the partners you authorize, such as your lender or insurer.

faqs.q: Can tracking trigger payment?
faqs.a: Yes. Agreed milestones, such as arrival or delivery confirmation, can release escrow payments automatically.

cap-tracking.title: Real-Time Shipment & Cold-Chain Tracking for Food | T57
cap-tracking.description: Track food shipments across sea, air and road, with live temperature monitoring, predicted arrival and alerts, all on one T57 trade record.

cap-customs.name: Customs & Documentation Hub
cap-customs.answer: Prepare export and import documents once, and clear food through customs faster.

faqs.q: Does T57 file customs declarations?
faqs.a: No. Licensed customs brokers file declarations, using the documents prepared on T57.

faqs.q: Is pre-clearance available in every country?
faqs.a: Pre-clearance depends on each customs authority's procedures. Where it is not available, T57 still sends complete, checked documents to the broker before arrival.

faqs.q: Are AI-suggested HS codes final?
faqs.a: No. They are suggestions for a broker or member to confirm. The final classification is the declarant's responsibility.

cap-customs.title: Customs & Trade Documentation Hub for Food | T57
cap-customs.description: Generate export and import documents from your contract, get HS code guidance and consistency checks, and pre-clear food shipments with vetted brokers on T57.

cap-intelligence.name: Intelligence & Data
cap-intelligence.answer: Trade with the full picture: prices, supply, counterparties and markets, inside every deal.

faqs.q: Where does T57's data come from?
faqs.a: Public market and trade sources, licensed data partners, and anonymized, aggregated data from trades on T57.

faqs.q: Is my trade data shared with other members?
faqs.a: No. Individual trades are never shown. They contribute only to anonymized, aggregated statistics.

faqs.q: Is intelligence included in membership?
faqs.a: Core intelligence is included. Higher membership tiers include deeper data, credit reports and forecasts.

cap-intelligence.title: Food Trade Intelligence | Prices, Forecasts, Credit | T57
cap-intelligence.description: Food price index, supply and demand forecasts, AI negotiation support, credit reports and port trade data, built into food trade on T57.

cap-price-index.name: Live Food Price Index
cap-price-index.h1: Today's food prices, from real trades.
cap-price-index.answer: Current food prices by product, grade and origin, built from real trades.

faqs.q: How is the T57 index calculated?
faqs.a: It combines public market data, licensed data partners and anonymized, aggregated prices from verified T57 trades, with methods that prevent any single member's price from being identified.

faqs.q: How often is it updated?
faqs.a: It updates as new market data arrives and as verified trades close on T57. Some lines update daily, others weekly, depending on trade volume.

faqs.q: Can non-members see the index?
faqs.a: A selection of index lines is public on the T57 website. Full detail, history and alerts are available to members.

cap-price-index.title: Live Food Price Index by Product & Origin | T57
cap-price-index.description: Current food prices by product, grade and origin from public data and anonymized verified trades. Benchmark quotes and set alerts on T57.

cap-negotiations.name: AI Negotiations Engine
cap-negotiations.h1: Negotiate with data and AI behind you.
cap-negotiations.answer: Negotiate every food deal with market data and AI preparation behind you.

faqs.q: Does the AI negotiate on my behalf?
faqs.a: No. It prepares and suggests. You decide what to offer, counter or accept, and nothing is sent without your confirmation.

faqs.q: Can the other side see the engine's suggestions to me?
faqs.a: No. Your briefs and suggestions are private to you.

faqs.q: What data does the engine use?
faqs.a: The T57 price index, anonymized and aggregated trade data, the counterparty's public T57 profile and track record, and your own costs and history if you choose to add them.

cap-negotiations.title: AI Negotiations Engine for Food Trade | T57
cap-negotiations.description: AI that prepares negotiating briefs, benchmarks offers and suggests counter-offers for food deals, while people make every decision, on T57.

cap-equipment-rental.name: Equipment & Technology Rental
cap-equipment-rental.h1: Rent the technology you cannot afford to own.
cap-equipment-rental.answer: Tractors, drones, sensors, cold rooms and testing, booked by the day, the hectare or the job.

faqs.q: Can I list my equipment or drone for rent?
faqs.a: Yes. Verified members list equipment and services with prices, areas served and availability.

faqs.q: Do I need to know how to operate it?
faqs.a: No. Book it with a trained operator, or book the job alone, such as spraying 10 hectares.

faqs.q: Who is responsible if something breaks?
faqs.a: The rental terms, condition records and any insurance set out responsibility. Disputes are handled under those terms and the payment partner's rules.

faqs.q: What happens to owners with poor ratings?
faqs.a: Ratings come only from recorded jobs. Repeated upheld complaints lead to suspension and then removal from T57.

cap-equipment-rental.title: Rent Farm Equipment, Drones & Agritech | T57
cap-equipment-rental.description: Rent tractors, drones, sensors, cold rooms and testing from verified owners, by the day, the hectare or the job, with escrow payments on T57.

cap-hire-expert.name: Hire an Expert
cap-hire-expert.h1: The right expert, for the price of a meal.
cap-hire-expert.answer: Agronomists, inspectors, food scientists and packaging specialists across the food ecosystem, booked by the job and rated by members.

faqs.q: How are experts checked?
faqs.a: Identity, qualifications and references are verified before an expert can take jobs.

faqs.q: What if the advice is wrong or the job is not done?
faqs.a: You can raise a dispute before payment is released. Upheld complaints count against the expert, and repeated ones lead to removal.

faqs.q: Do experts recommend chemicals?
faqs.a: Experts recommend only products approved in the client's country and record the dose they advise.

faqs.q: Can my company offer services?
faqs.a: Yes. Firms join as service providers; individuals join as experts.

cap-hire-expert.title: Hire a Food & Agriculture Expert | T57
cap-hire-expert.description: Hire verified agronomists, inspectors, food scientists and packaging experts by the job, with prices agreed up front, escrow payment and ratings, on T57.

ai-native.name: AI Native
ai-native.h1: AI in every step of the trade. People make every decision.
ai-native.answer: T57 is AI-native. Here is what that means for your business.

faqs.q: What does "AI-native" mean at T57?
faqs.a: AI is built into every step of the trade, from matching and pricing to compliance and documents, rather than added as a separate tool.

faqs.q: Does AI make decisions about my business?
faqs.a: AI makes suggestions and flags issues. People make decisions, and every adverse decision is reviewed by a person.

faqs.q: What data does T57's AI use?
faqs.a: Verified trade records, public market, trade and climate data, licensed data from partners, and farmer knowledge recorded with consent. Individual members' data is never shared with other members.

faqs.q: Why small, local models?
faqs.a: Food is global but hyper-local. Small models trained for a region, crop and value chain understand local conditions and languages better, cost less to run and are easier to test and explain.

ai-native.title: AI-Native Food Trade Platform | How T57 Uses AI
ai-native.description: Small, local AI models for matching, pricing, forecasting, compliance and documents across food trade. AI advises, people decide, on T57.

ai-matchmaking.name: AI Trade Matchmaking
ai-matchmaking.h1: The right partner, in minutes, not weeks.
ai-matchmaking.answer: Find the right verified buyer or supplier in minutes, ranked by fit and track record.

faqs.q: Can suppliers pay to rank higher?
faqs.a: No. Ranking is based on fit, verification and track record, never on payment.

faqs.q: Why was a particular partner suggested?
faqs.a: Every suggestion shows its main reasons, such as product match, capacity, corridor experience and on-time performance.

ai-matchmaking.title: AI Trade Matchmaking for Food Buyers & Suppliers | T57
ai-matchmaking.description: AI ranks verified food buyers and suppliers by specification, capacity, corridor and track record, and explains every match, on T57.

ai-negotiations.name: AI Negotiations Engine
ai-negotiations.h1: Walk into every negotiation knowing the market.
ai-negotiations.answer: AI that prepares every negotiation with market data, and leaves every decision to you.

faqs.q: Does the AI negotiate on my behalf?
faqs.a: No. It prepares and suggests. You decide every offer and acceptance.

faqs.q: Can both parties use the engine in the same deal?
faqs.a: Yes. Each party gets its own private brief based on the same public market data.

ai-negotiations.title: AI Negotiation Support for Food Trade | T57 AI Native
ai-negotiations.description: How T57's negotiation AI benchmarks offers, values payment and delivery terms and suggests counter-offers, while people make every decision.

ai-orders.name: LLM-Based Trade Orders
ai-orders.h1: A voice note in. A confirmed order out.
ai-orders.answer: Turn a WhatsApp message or voice note into a confirmed, structured trade order.

faqs.q: Which languages are supported?
faqs.a: Arabic, English, Hindi, Malay and Turkish, with more added as T57 grows into new markets.

faqs.q: What happens if the AI is unsure?
faqs.a: It asks a short question instead of guessing, and the order is not sent until you confirm.

ai-orders.title: LLM-Based Trade Orders by WhatsApp & Voice | T57 AI Native
ai-orders.description: How T57's language models turn WhatsApp messages and voice notes into confirmed, structured food trade orders, in Arabic and local languages.

ai-price-index.name: Live Food Price Index, AI-Powered
ai-price-index.h1: A price for every grade and origin, explained.
ai-price-index.answer: An AI-built price for every product, grade and origin, explained in plain language.

faqs.q: How accurate are the AI estimates?
faqs.a: Each price shows a confidence level. Accuracy is measured by comparing estimates with later verified trades, and results are published by product group.

faqs.q: Can the index be manipulated by fake trades?
faqs.a: Only trades between verified members count, outliers are detected and down-weighted, and no single trade can move the index alone.

ai-price-index.title: AI-Powered Food Price Index | T57 AI Native
ai-price-index.description: How T57's AI estimates prices for every food product, grade and origin from market data and verified trades, with confidence levels and explanations.

ai-forecasting.name: Supply & Demand Forecasting
ai-forecasting.h1: See shortages and surpluses coming, weeks ahead.
ai-forecasting.answer: See shortages, surpluses and price turns coming, weeks before they reach you.

faqs.q: How far ahead do forecasts look?
faqs.a: From a few weeks to a season, depending on the product and the data available. Every forecast shows its range.

faqs.q: Can governments use the forecasts?
faqs.a: Yes. Governments and institutions can access aggregated supply status and forecasts through T57's food security view.

ai-forecasting.title: AI Supply & Demand Forecasting for Food | T57 AI Native
ai-forecasting.description: AI forecasts of food supply, demand and prices by product and origin, with supply status signals and alerts for buyers, sellers and governments.

ai-risk.name: Risk Intelligence & Heatmaps
ai-risk.h1: Every risk to your trade, on one map.
ai-risk.answer: See every risk to your trade on one map: counterparties, routes, markets and weather.

faqs.q: Can I see my own risk score?
faqs.a: Yes. Members can see the scores that relate to them and the main reasons, and can ask for a review.

faqs.q: Who else can see risk heatmaps?
faqs.a: Lenders and insurers see risk only for the trades you share with them. Governments see aggregated, anonymized views.

ai-risk.title: AI Risk Intelligence & Heatmaps for Food Trade | T57 AI Native
ai-risk.description: AI risk scores and heatmaps for counterparties, routes, markets and climate in food trade, with explainable factors and early-warning alerts, on T57.

ai-crop-yield.name: Crop & Yield Forecasting
ai-crop-yield.h1: Know your harvest before it happens.
ai-crop-yield.answer: Know how much your fields will produce, and when, before the harvest.

faqs.q: Do farmers need special equipment?
faqs.a: No. Forecasts use satellite and weather data. Farmers can add observations by voice or photo from a basic smartphone, or through their cooperative.

faqs.q: Who can see a farm's forecast?
faqs.a: The farmer or cooperative, and anyone they choose to share it with, such as a buyer or lender.

ai-crop-yield.title: AI Crop & Yield Forecasting | T57 AI Native
ai-crop-yield.description: Field-level yield and harvest forecasts from local AI models, satellite and weather data, and farmer knowledge, for farmers, cooperatives, buyers and lenders.

ai-profit-loss.name: Profit & Loss Prediction
ai-profit-loss.h1: Know if it will pay before you commit.
ai-profit-loss.answer: Know whether a crop, a trade or a season will make money before you commit.

faqs.q: Is the prediction a guarantee?
faqs.a: No. It shows the most likely outcome and a range, based on current data. Actual results depend on weather, markets and execution.

faqs.q: Can I add my own costs?
faqs.a: Yes. Adding your own costs makes predictions more accurate, and your data stays private.

ai-profit-loss.title: AI Profit & Loss Prediction for Food Trades | T57
ai-profit-loss.description: Predict the likely margin of a crop, contract or trade from yields, prices and costs, with break-even prices and scenario comparisons, on T57.

ai-crop-planning.name: AI Crop Planning & Analytics
ai-crop-planning.h1: Plant what the market will want.
ai-crop-planning.answer: Plan what to plant, when and how much, based on what the market will want.

faqs.q: Does the AI tell me exactly what to plant?
faqs.a: It recommends options with expected yields and margins. You decide, and you can adjust the plan at any time.

faqs.q: Can cooperatives plan for all their members?
faqs.a: Yes. Cooperatives can build plans across members' farms to balance supply and meet buyer demand.

ai-crop-planning.title: AI Crop Planning & Farm Analytics | T57 AI Native
ai-crop-planning.description: AI crop plans based on market demand, soil, water and climate, with expected yields, margins and season analytics, for farmers and cooperatives.

ai-agronomy.name: Agronomy Expert Network, AI-Assisted
ai-agronomy.h1: Farming advice in your language, in minutes.
ai-agronomy.answer: Expert farming advice in your own language, from AI first and agronomists when it matters.

faqs.q: Which languages does the agronomy AI speak?
faqs.a: Local languages in T57's markets, starting with Arabic, Hindi, Malay, Turkish and English and expanding to regional languages, including by voice.

faqs.q: Who are the agronomists?
faqs.a: Verified agronomists and agricultural experts who join T57 as service providers. Their qualifications are checked before they can advise.

ai-agronomy.title: AI Agronomy Advice for Farmers | T57 AI Native
ai-agronomy.description: Instant crop advice in local languages from AI, with verified agronomists for complex cases. Photo and voice diagnosis for farmers on T57.

ai-compliance.name: AI-Powered Compliance & KYC
ai-compliance.answer: Verify businesses and screen every trade faster, with people reviewing every adverse decision.

faqs.q: Can AI reject my application?
faqs.a: No. AI can flag issues, but only a person can make an adverse decision, and you can ask for a review.

faqs.q: How is my data protected?
faqs.a: Your data is used for verification and shared with partners only with your consent, under T57's privacy policy and applicable data protection laws.

ai-compliance.title: AI-Powered KYC, KYB & Compliance Screening | T57 AI Native
ai-compliance.description: AI document checks, ownership matching and sanctions screening for food businesses, with people reviewing every adverse decision, on T57.

ai-analytics.name: Predictive Trade Analytics Dashboard
ai-analytics.h1: See where your business is heading.
ai-analytics.answer: See where your trading business is heading, not just where it has been.

faqs.q: Do I need to upload my own data?
faqs.a: No. The dashboard is built from your activity on T57. You can add other data, such as costs, for better forecasts.

faqs.q: Can I share the dashboard with my lender?
faqs.a: Yes. You can share selected views with lenders or investors, with your consent.

ai-analytics.title: Predictive Trade Analytics Dashboard | T57 AI Native
ai-analytics.description: AI forecasts of volumes, margins and cash, with alerts on slow payers and supplier risk, and suggested actions for food trading businesses on T57.

ai-documents.name: AI Trade Document Generation
ai-documents.h1: One accepted quote. Every document, checked.
ai-documents.answer: Generate contracts, invoices and trade documents from one accepted quote, checked by AI.

faqs.q: Are AI-generated contracts legally binding?
faqs.a: Contracts become binding when the parties sign them. T57 uses standard trade terms, and members can have their own lawyers review any document.

faqs.q: Which documents can be generated?
faqs.a: Contracts, pro forma and commercial invoices, packing lists, LC applications and supporting documents, and data for certificates and customs declarations.

ai-documents.title: AI Trade Document Generation & Checks | T57 AI Native
ai-documents.description: Generate contracts, invoices and packing lists from the accepted quote, and catch LC and customs discrepancies with AI checks, on T57.

platform.name: Platform
platform.h1: The food operating system. One platform, one record.
platform.answer: The food operating system: one platform that connects every party, service and record in food trade.

faqs.q: Is T57 a marketplace or a platform?
faqs.a: T57 is a platform: a members-only verified trade club with the infrastructure to run trades end to end. Members trade directly with each other on it.

faqs.q: Can T57 connect to my existing systems?
faqs.a: Yes. T57 offers APIs for ERP, accounting and procurement systems, and connects to partner banks, insurers and logistics providers.

faqs.q: Where is my data stored?
faqs.a: On Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure across regions, designed to meet each market's data-residency requirements.

platform.title: T57 Platform | The Food Operating System
platform.description: Verified identity, one trade record, connected finance and logistics partners, AI and blockchain on one secure platform built for food trade.

platform-trade-cycle.name: One Trade, Every Step
platform-trade-cycle.h1: One trade. Every step. One record.
platform-trade-cycle.answer: Agree a price, ship, insure, finance, pay and clear customs on one platform, with every party verified and every step on one record.

faqs.q: Does T57 lend money or move the goods?
faqs.a: No. T57 is the platform. Licensed banks and finance partners fund trades, licensed partners provide escrow and insurance, and logistics partners move and store the goods.

faqs.q: Can I keep my current freight forwarder?
faqs.a: Yes. Invite them to T57 and they work on the same trade record, or choose a vetted forwarder in your city by rating and reviews.

faqs.q: How do smart contracts protect a lender?
faqs.a: Funds are released in stages as milestones such as loading, departure and arrival are verified. If a milestone fails, later payments stop.

faqs.q: Which ports support pre-arrival clearance?
faqs.a: T57 prepares and checks documents before shipment for every trade. Where a port or customs authority runs pre-arrival clearance, the documents can be reviewed before the goods arrive.

faqs.q: Is there a size limit on a trade?
faqs.a: No. T57 is built for anything from a single container to national food-reserve tenders of millions of tonnes.

faqs.q: When will carbon credits be available?
faqs.a: Carbon income for farmers is planned for phase two, through specialist partners.

platform-trade-cycle.title: One Trade, Every Step: Food Trade on One Record | T57
platform-trade-cycle.description: Agree a price, ship, insure, finance, pay and clear customs for any food on one platform, with verified parties, competing lenders and milestone-based finance.

platform-domestic.name: Domestic B2B Trade
platform-domestic.h1: From the factory to every shop in town.
platform-domestic.answer: Local factories and farms sell direct to supermarkets, restaurants and offices at factory price, by the carton, delivered to the door.

faqs.q: Does T57 charge listing fees or rebates?
faqs.a: No. There are no listing fees, slotting rebates or forced promotions. Sellers set their own prices. T57 membership options are on the Pricing page.

faqs.q: Who delivers the orders?
faqs.a: Licensed local logistics partners, booked from the order. Sellers can also invite the delivery company they already use.

faqs.q: Can buyers pay later?
faqs.a: Yes, where a licensed B2B credit or pay-later partner approves the buyer. T57 does not lend.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order?
faqs.a: Each seller sets it, for example 2, 5 or 20 cartons, with lower prices for larger orders.

faqs.q: Can farms and cooperatives sell this way?
faqs.a: Yes. Farms, cooperatives and food processors can list fresh and packed products for local business buyers.

faqs.q: Which countries is this for?
faqs.a: Domestic B2B trade is built for each of T57's founding markets: Saudi Arabia, the UAE, India, Malaysia and Türkiye.

platform-domestic.title: Domestic B2B Food Trade | Factory to Shop, Direct | T57
platform-domestic.description: Local factories and farms sell direct to supermarkets, restaurants and offices at factory price, by the carton, with local delivery and pay-later partners.

platform-architecture.name: System Architecture
platform-architecture.h1: Cloud-native. API-first. Built for regulated trade.
platform-architecture.answer: A cloud-native, API-first architecture built for verified, regulated, cross-border food trade.

faqs.q: Which cloud does T57 use?
faqs.a: Microsoft Azure, across regions, designed to meet each market's data-residency requirements.

faqs.q: Does T57 offer APIs?
faqs.a: Yes. Members and partners can integrate through REST APIs and webhooks. Documentation is available to approved members and partners.

faqs.q: Can partners keep their data in their own systems?
faqs.a: Yes. Partners exchange only the data each trade needs, under agreement and with consent, and keep their own systems of record.

platform-architecture.title: T57 Architecture | Cloud-Native, API-First Platform
platform-architecture.description: Region-aware cloud on Microsoft Azure, modular services, partner connectors and member APIs, built for verified, regulated food trade across borders.

platform-roadmap.name: Platform Roadmap
platform-roadmap.h1: How the platform grows, one strong layer at a time.
platform-roadmap.answer: How the T57 platform grows: from verified trade, to connected finance, to a food ecosystem.

faqs.q: Can I join T57 now?
faqs.a: Yes. Membership applications are open, starting in the founding markets.

faqs.q: How do I find out when new capabilities reach my market?
faqs.a: Members are notified in the platform, and partners receive integration updates directly.

faqs.q: Can my organization help shape the roadmap?
faqs.a: Yes. Partners and institutional members can join pilot programs and advisory groups.

platform-roadmap.title: T57 Platform Roadmap | Trade, Finance, Ecosystem
platform-roadmap.description: How the T57 platform grows in stages, from verified food trade to connected finance and a full food ecosystem, across founding and expanding markets.

platform-intelligence.name: Intelligence Layer
platform-intelligence.h1: Small, local AI, trained on verified trade.
platform-intelligence.answer: The AI layer that learns from verified trade and supports every decision on T57.

faqs.q: Does T57 use my data to train AI?
faqs.a: T57 uses verified trade data in anonymized, aggregated form to improve its models. Your individual data is never shown to other members, and farmer knowledge is used only with consent.

faqs.q: Why not just use a large general AI model?
faqs.a: Large models are useful for language and documents, and T57 uses them where they fit. For crops, markets and local conditions, small models trained on local data are more accurate, cheaper to run and easier to test and explain.

faqs.q: Can I challenge an AI decision?
faqs.a: Yes. Every adverse decision comes with a reason and a route to contest it, and a person reviews it.

platform-intelligence.title: T57 Intelligence Layer | Small, Local AI for Food Trade
platform-intelligence.description: Small, local AI models trained on verified trade data and consented farmer knowledge, governed so people review every adverse decision.

platform-blockchain.name: Blockchain & Smart Contract Layer
platform-blockchain.h1: Records no one can quietly change. Payments that follow proof.
platform-blockchain.answer: Tamper-evident records, tokenized documents and milestone payments that every party can trust.

faqs.q: Is my trade data public on the blockchain?
faqs.a: No. Only digital fingerprints of key records are anchored. Document contents stay in secure storage, visible only to authorized parties.

faqs.q: Do I need cryptocurrency to use the blockchain layer?
faqs.a: No. The blockchain layer works in the background. Members pay and get paid in normal currencies through licensed partners, unless they choose alternative payments where lawful.

faqs.q: What happens if a milestone is disputed?
faqs.a: The smart contract pauses release, and the dispute is handled under the contract and the partner's rules.

platform-blockchain.title: Blockchain & Smart Contracts for Food Trade | T57
platform-blockchain.description: Tamper-evident record anchoring, tokenized trade documents and smart-contract milestone payments, with privacy and licensed partners, on T57.

platform-security.name: Security Architecture
platform-security.h1: Security built in, not bolted on.
platform-security.answer: Protect every trade, document and member with security built into the platform.

faqs.q: Where is my data stored?

faqs.q: How does T57 support national and regional food-security strategies in practice?
faqs.a: Many countries are now expanding strategic reserves and silo capacity to hold months’ worth of essential commodities. T57 complements such physical infrastructure by tracking self-sufficiency, stock levels, and import exposure in real time. This combination of physical reserves and digital intelligence helps governments move from reactive to anticipatory food-security management.

faqs.q: Why is it important to channel private and impact capital into agriculture and food systems, beyond public budgets?
faqs.a: Despite agriculture’s historical role in employment and food security, global investors are only now seeking credible, measurable pathways to support food systems as part of their climate and SDG commitments. T57 helps governments present investable, data-backed opportunities, from model support centers to special agri zones and CSR programs, with transparent performance and impact tracking that meets both regulatory and investor expectations.

financiers.h1: Finance verified food trade, with less risk.
financiers.answer: Every deal comes with verified parties, documents and shipment data, from deal to settlement.

faqs.q: How does T57 handle disputes and reduce risks for financiers and investors?
faqs.a: T57 reduces risk through its curated club membership model, which ensures vetted, credible counterparties in a high-trust environment. Its virtual trade desk supports execution, manages disputes, oversees documentation, and ensures consistent transaction follow-through for greater investor confidence.

faqs.q: Why is food and agri finance an important opportunity for investors now?
faqs.a: Global food import demand remains enormous: FAO puts the global food import bill at $2.22 trillion in 2025, which underlines the scale and persistence of trade-linked financing needs in food markets.

faqs.q: Is trade finance generally considered a lower risk than other forms of credit exposure?
faqs.a: Yes. The ICC Trade Register highlights that trade, supply chain, and export finance products continue to exhibit low-risk profiles and resilient default performance across challenging market conditions.

faqs.q: Why do financiers need stronger diligence and monitoring tools in agri markets?
faqs.a: Food and agri transactions often involve fragmented supply chains, cross-border counterparties, and climate or logistics volatility, which makes visibility and verification especially valuable. The International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) notes that small-scale producers remain underserved by finance, highlighting that large financing needs go unmet because risk gaps discourage capital.

financiers.description: Deploy capital into curated, contract-backed food and agri trades, with faster due diligence, full transaction visibility and tighter counterparty risk.

sellers.name: Sellers and Exporters
sellers.h1: Sell to verified buyers, and get paid safely.
sellers.answer: Find buyers, agree terms and get paid, with finance and logistics on one platform.

faqs.q: How does T57's virtual trade desk help in disputes and risk management?
faqs.a: The virtual trade desk acts as a risk manager. In the event of disputes, the desk steps in to mediate, enforce agreed-upon terms and protect the seller's interests. If a buyer becomes insolvent or defaults, T57 shifts to a commission-based recovery and resale approach, helping redirect goods or recover value.

faqs.q: How does a platform help with the financing gap?
faqs.a: Dedicated trade platforms that provide rich transaction and compliance data can lower perceived risk for financiers, improving access to credit and reducing the cost of capital. T57 is designed to expose this data in an auditable way so that funders can underwrite your deals with greater confidence.

faqs.q: Why is documentation and certification such a big issue in food exports?
faqs.a: Food exports are subject to stringent import-country inspection and certification regimes. Incomplete or incorrect certification can lead to rejection or non-compliance at the border. A system that centralizes documents, links them to lots and shipments, and validates certifications reduces the risk of costly rejections and delays.

faqs.q: Can better intelligence really help in volatile export markets?
faqs.a: Agricultural prices remain exposed to extreme weather, changing biofuel policies and rising trade barriers. Exporters using structured market, crop and price intelligence are better able to adjust sourcing and pricing to protect margins.
